# Faithful paywall V2 illustrations

Four reference-preserving image edits remove all labels and add clear peach-glass
icon discs to the supplied palette, hair, updo and skincare card photography.
Typography is rendered separately in `paywall-v2.js`; offers and actions are
native interactive elements. These are not full-screen screenshot overlays.

The original composition and subject placement are the acceptance criteria.
Generated fine photographic detail and glyph strokes are not pixel-identical to
the originals. No transparency or silhouette masks are used on these cards.

`scripts/prepare-paywall-faithful-assets.cjs` trims the outside background and
exports the approved edits at twice their reference layout size as WebP.
